tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground (body). Text: `foreground` (19.8:1 light, 19.0:1 dark), `muted-foreground` (4.7:1 / 7.6:1).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and headings on `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card surface. Light: same as `background`; cards are set apart by a 10% `foreground` ring, not by fill. Dark: one step lighter than `background`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces (menus, popovers). Defined by shadcn; no popover is used yet.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill: the default Button, Progress indicator, primary Badge. The only strong fill in the UI.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `primary` (17.2:1 light, 14.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button and Badge fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: Progress track, card footer (at 50%), hover backgrounds of outline and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, captions, counts, placeholders. On `background`/`card` 4.7:1 (light), 7.6:1 (dark). On `muted` only 4.3:1 in light, under 4.5:1: keep it off `muted` fills for body-size text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent fill (shadcn naming; equals `muted` in this neutral theme). Not used directly by the app.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and the "wrong" verdict: Alert destructive text, destructive Button/Badge (as a 10–20% tint with this colour as text), invalid-field borders. As text on `background`: 4.8:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card footer rule, outline Button border, default `*` border colour.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form control borders (Input, Textarea, NativeSelect); in dark, also the 30% fill of outline buttons.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn at 50% opacity, 3px. Light: 2.6:1 on `background` at full strength, under the 3:1 floor for focus indicators (source value kept).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1. Defined by shadcn; no charts yet.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. Defined by shadcn; no charts yet.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Defined by shadcn; no charts yet.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Defined by shadcn; no charts yet.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. Defined by shadcn; no charts yet.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar surface. Defined by shadcn; the app has no sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar`. Unused.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Sidebar primary item. Unused; the only blue in the source (dark theme).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`. Unused.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Sidebar hover fill. Unused.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`. Unused.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar hairline. Unused.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Sidebar focus ring. Unused.

tokens.name: verdict-exact
tokens.usage: "Correct" feedback panel: border at 40%, fill at 10% (`border-verdict-exact/40 bg-verdict-exact/10`); text stays `foreground`. Same value as Tailwind green-600. Never text: 3.2:1 on light `background`; the verdict is always named in words.

tokens.name: verdict-typo
tokens.usage: "Almost: watch the spelling" panel: border at 40%, fill at 10%; text stays `foreground`. Same value as Tailwind amber-500. Never text: 2.2:1 on light `background`.

tokens.name: verdict-wrong
tokens.usage: "Not quite" panel: border at 40%, fill at 10% of `destructive`. Alias of `destructive`.

families.heading: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: term
styles.usage: The new word on a present step (text-3xl font-semibold), with lang set to the target language.

styles.name: definition
styles.usage: Definition under a new word and the typed answer (text-lg), in `muted-foreground` for the definition.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: CardTitle (text-base leading-snug font-medium, the heading family).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Defaults for every course. A course can override grading on its own page.
styles.usage: Default UI text: cards, alerts, descriptions (text-sm).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, alert titles (text-sm font-medium).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts, hints, unit names, next-review time (text-xs), in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: CSV text and inline code in help text (font-mono text-xs).

spacing.note: Tailwind 4 spacing: every gap, padding and size is a multiple of this base (gap-4 = 4 × spacing = 16px).

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Base unit (4px). Steps in use: 1 (4px) and 1.5 (6px) inside label/field stacks, 2–3 (8–12px) between controls, 4 (16px) card padding and grid gaps, 6 (24px) between form rows, 8 (32px) between page sections and main padding-block. Controls are 8 units tall (32px); study inputs 11 (44px).

radius.note: shadcn derives a scale from one base: sm 0.6×, md 0.8×, lg 1×, xl 1.4×, 2xl 1.8×, 3xl 2.2×, 4xl 2.6×.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base radius (10px) = radius-lg: buttons, inputs, alerts, feedback panels. Cards use 1.4× (14px), badges 2.6× (fully rounded at their 20px height), switches and progress tracks are fully round.
